module: Flowgraph node "ID by Name" (simple category). Finds the id of the first scene object with a given name (scenetree.findObject). Input: name (string, hidden; otherwise the name is in self.data.name). Outputs: objID (number) and exist (bool, hidden). The found id is remembered until the start/end of a mission or the start of the graph.
notes: Once the id is found, it is kept even if the pin's name later changes and the object is no longer found.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Uses the name pin if it is connected, looks up the object and writes objID and exist.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: forgets the remembered id.

onClientStartMission.desc: Start-of-mission hook: forgets the remembered id.

_executionStarted.desc: Forgets the remembered id when the graph starts.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the current name and id in the middle of the node.
